_description: Parameterized request letter templates. Placeholders use __DOUBLE_UNDERSCORE__ format. State-specific legal phrases come from template_fragments in state YAML files; agency contact info from agencies.json; user input fills the rest.

templates.name: ALPR Detection Data
templates.description: Request captured license plate data, images, and metadata for a specific time window.
templates.use_when: You want to see what the cameras actually recorded — plates, vehicle descriptions, images, timestamps.
templates.body:
To: __AGENCY_RAO_OR_HEAD__
From: __USER_NAME__
Date: __TODAY_DATE__
Subject: __STATE_SHORT_NAME__ Request — ALPR/Flock Safety Detection Data

Dear Records Access Officer:

__STATE_STATUTE_INVOCATION__, I request access to and copies of the following records:

All automated license plate reader (ALPR) detection logs, images, and associated metadata captured by any ALPR device (including but not limited to Flock Safety cameras) operated by or on behalf of __AGENCY_NAME__ during the following time period:

Date: __USER_DATE__
Time: __USER_TIME_START__ to __USER_TIME_END__
__IF_LOCATION__Location: __USER_LOCATION__
__ENDIF__
This includes but is not limited to: license plate numbers, vehicle make/model/color, vehicle images, detection timestamps, camera identification numbers, and any alerts generated.

__STATE_ELECTRONIC_DELIVERY__

__STATE_FEE_CAP_NOTICE__

__STATE_RESPONSE_REMINDER__

Thank you for your assistance.

__USER_NAME__
__USER_ADDRESS__
__USER_EMAIL__

templates.name: Contracts, Policies & Data Sharing
templates.description: Request the Flock/ALPR contract, usage policies, data retention rules, and data-sharing agreements.
templates.use_when: You want to understand the terms under which your municipality adopted surveillance cameras — cost, data access rules, who else can see the data.
templates.body:
To: __AGENCY_RAO_OR_HEAD__
From: __USER_NAME__
Date: __TODAY_DATE__
Subject: __STATE_SHORT_NAME__ Request — ALPR/Flock Safety Contracts and Policies

Dear Records Access Officer:

__STATE_STATUTE_INVOCATION__, I request access to and copies of the following records:

1. All contracts, agreements, memoranda of understanding, and amendments between __AGENCY_NAME__ and Flock Safety, Inc. (or any other ALPR technology vendor) currently in effect or in effect at any time since January 1, __USER_START_DATE__.

2. All policies, procedures, protocols, and guidelines governing the use of automated license plate reader technology by __AGENCY_NAME__, including data retention schedules, access controls, and audit procedures.

3. All data-sharing agreements permitting other law enforcement agencies to access ALPR data collected by __AGENCY_NAME__, or permitting __AGENCY_NAME__ to access data collected by other agencies.

4. All records of payments made to Flock Safety, Inc. (or any ALPR vendor) since January 1, __USER_START_DATE__.

5. Audit logs showing which personnel accessed the ALPR system and what queries were run, for the most recent __USER_AUDIT_DAYS__-day period.

__STATE_ELECTRONIC_DELIVERY__

__STATE_FEE_CAP_NOTICE__

__STATE_RESPONSE_REMINDER__

Thank you for your assistance.

__USER_NAME__
__USER_ADDRESS__
__USER_EMAIL__

templates.name: Administrative Appeal (Denial)
templates.description: Appeal a denied records request to the agency head.
templates.use_when: Your request was explicitly denied and you received a written denial citing a specific exemption.

user_fields.label: Why the exemption doesn't apply
user_fields.placeholder: e.g., No active investigation has been identified, and no record-by-record justification was provided.

templates.body:
To: __AGENCY_APPEALS_OFFICER__
__IF_ADVISORY_BODY__cc: __ADVISORY_BODY_NAME__
    __ADVISORY_BODY_ADDRESS__
__ENDIF__From: __USER_NAME__
Date: __TODAY_DATE__
Subject: __STATE_SHORT_NAME__ Appeal__IF_FOIL_REF__ — __USER_FOIL_REF____ENDIF__

Dear __AGENCY_APPEALS_OFFICER__:

I write to appeal the denial of my __STATE_SHORT_NAME__ request submitted on __USER_ORIGINAL_DATE__, in which I requested __USER_RECORDS_DESCRIPTION__.

On __USER_DENIAL_DATE__, I received a written denial citing __USER_EXEMPTION_CITED__. This denial lacks a reasonable basis because __USER_COUNTER_ARGUMENT__.

I request immediate release of the requested records.

__STATE_APPEAL_DEADLINE_WARNING__

__IF_ADVISORY_BODY__I have copied the __ADVISORY_BODY_NAME__ on this appeal as required by statute.
__ENDIF__
Thank you for your prompt attention.

__USER_NAME__
__USER_ADDRESS__
__USER_EMAIL__

templates.name: Administrative Appeal (Non-Response)
templates.description: Appeal when the agency simply never responded to your request.
templates.use_when: More than five business days have passed and you received no acknowledgment, denial, or estimated response date.
templates.body:
To: __AGENCY_APPEALS_OFFICER__
__IF_ADVISORY_BODY__cc: __ADVISORY_BODY_NAME__
    __ADVISORY_BODY_ADDRESS__
__ENDIF__From: __USER_NAME__
Date: __TODAY_DATE__
Subject: __STATE_SHORT_NAME__ Appeal (Non-Response)__IF_FOIL_REF__ — __USER_FOIL_REF____ENDIF__

Dear __AGENCY_APPEALS_OFFICER__:

I write to appeal the constructive denial of my __STATE_SHORT_NAME__ request submitted on __USER_ORIGINAL_DATE__, in which I requested __USER_RECORDS_DESCRIPTION__.

More than __STATE_INITIAL_RESPONSE_DAYS__ business days have elapsed since my request was received, and I have received no acknowledgment, denial, or estimated response date. Under applicable law, this constitutes a constructive denial.

I request immediate release of the requested records.

__STATE_APPEAL_DEADLINE_WARNING__

__IF_ADVISORY_BODY__I have copied the __ADVISORY_BODY_NAME__ on this appeal as required by statute.
__ENDIF__
Thank you for your prompt attention.

__USER_NAME__
__USER_ADDRESS__
__USER_EMAIL__
